name: Mapping the Shrines of Pakistan
description: Bilingual (English/Urdu) interactive map and scholarly archive of 169 sacred sites across Pakistan — Muslim Sufi shrines, Hindu temples, Sikh gurdwaras, Nanakpanthi/Udasi darbars, Jain temples and secular memorials — with provenance-tracked sources. Built with Vite 5, React 18, and TypeScript; data licensed ODbL-1.0; code licensed MIT.
abstract: This project combines a schema-validated Frictionless Data Package (169 sites; coordinates, descriptions, provenance) with a static-site web application featuring bilingual EN/Urdu support, RTL layout, dark mode, and an interactive Leaflet map. Designed for Harvard computational humanities research and Zenodo/Dataverse deposit.
